page: Amazon Web Services c7gd.large is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture, featuring AWS Graviton3 processors based on the arm64 ARMv8 Neoverse-V1 microarchitecture. The instance provides 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs running at 2.6 GHz, with 1 thread per core. Memory configuration includes 4.0 GB of RAM (2.0 GB per core), paired with 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB shared L3 cache. Local storage includes a dedicated 118 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and network capability provides a 1 Gbps baseline bandwidth. No physical GPU accelerators are included.

Benchmark data demonstrates competitive single-thread performance alongside predictable scaling constraints typical of a two-core profile. In single-core evaluations, the instance reached a stress-ng score of 1532.88 and a Geekbench score of 1473.0, both settling in the middle 50% tier. Multi-core performance scales linearly with its 2 vCPUs, posting 3041.67 on stress-ng and 2649.0 on Geekbench multi-core. Cryptographic operations utilize dedicated ARM hardware acceleration with aes enabled. In data handling benchmarks, gzip compression achieved 24.25 GB/sec, while static web serving throughput reached 3.58 GB/sec and Redis SET operations achieved 3.06 million operations per second.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, coupled with attached low-latency NVMe SSD storage, delivers an efficient balance for lightweight compute-bound workloads requiring fast temporary scratch space. Because compute resources are limited to two cores and 4.0 GB RAM, multi-threaded throughput and memory-dense analytics are bounded. This server is best suited for microservices, front-end web serving, continuous integration runners, lightweight caching nodes, and batch processing tasks benefiting from direct NVMe I/O.
description: Amazon Web Services c7gd.large is a compute-optimized instance powered by the 64-bit ARM Neoverse-V1 architecture on the AWS Nitro System. It provides 2 dedicated vCPUs from 2 physical cores running at 2.6 GHz, accompanied by 4.0 GB of system memory and an integrated 118 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume. Baseline network throughput is rated at 1 Gbps, with zero GPUs present. Benchmarks show solid single-core efficiency, achieving 1473.0 in Geekbench single-core tests and 24.25 GB/sec in gzip compression, while multi-core workloads scale in line with its two-thread design. The bundled high-speed local NVMe storage and dedicated core execution make c7gd.large an economical choice for front-end web serving, microservice hosting, CI/CD worker nodes, and lightweight caching setups needing fast local scratch disks.
